message.Title: Public Preview: Standard V2 NAT Gateway and StandardV2 Public IPs

Body.Content:
StandardV2 SKU NAT Gateway is now in public preview, delivering next-generation capabilities for scalable and resilient outbound connectivity. 

New offerings: 

  • Zone-Redundancy: Built for high availability in availability zone supported regions. Traffic survives single-zone failures with no extra configurations required. 

  • Enhanced performance: Supports up to 100 Gbps of throughput and 10 million packets per second, double the Standard SKU capacity. 

  • Dual-stack support: Supports up to 16 IPv6 and 16 IPv4 public IP addresses for future ready connectivity. 

  • Traffic insights with Flow logs: Provides IP-level traffic insights for troubleshooting and verifying compliance with organizational policies and requirements. 

  • StandardV2 Public IPs: StandardV2 NAT Gateway requires StandardV2 IPs; Standard SKU IPs are not supported. 

Pricing and availability: 

  • Same price as the Standard SKU NAT Gateway. 

  • Available in select regions, with broader rollout planned. 

  • Deploy through CLI, Powershell, Bicep and ARM. Portal support coming soon.  

Learn more: 

  • StandardV2 NAT Gateway  

  • StandardV2 Public IPs
